title: Understand verification boundaries
statement: As a developer reading Quality, I can distinguish a defined verification approach from its implementation links and historical execution metadata so CI results never become Saga document verdicts.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Quality coverage, readiness, health and the definition reader are independent of missing, passing, failing, blocked, skipped, stale or conflicting run records; legacy runs remain accessible as inert immutable history.

Implementation evidence exposes its pinned test revision and exact code references; changed definitions or stale code are visible mapping issues without requiring a fresh run or executing recorded commands.
